description: Code Enforcement Active Pipeline is a series of datasets listed in City of New Orleans open data portal (data.nola.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of New Orleans. Please note that this data set contains Code Enforcement cases from May 12th, 2009 to present. For the purpose of analyzing active cases, please filter for "Open" on the first column, "O/C". Cases are closed in when the in rem judgement is paid and violations are abated. Please see for more information. Coverage: New Orleans. The portal lists 3 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the category Housing, Land Use, and Blight. Its tags are violation, case, blightstatus, active. The table has 36 columns. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons 1.0 Universal (Public Domain Dedication). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support pipeline routing and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-nola-gov-portal.
